title: Wire ruff lint and coverage gates into the development workflow
description: pyproject.toml declares [tool.ruff] and [tool.coverage.run] but ruff and coverage/pytest-cov are not installed and never invoked. There is no CI workflow. Branch coverage is configured but not measured. These tools should be installed and wired into a pre-commit or CI gate so lint and coverage are enforced. Verified finding (assertions.md §5).
notes: Installed ruff and pytest-cov into the .venv and pinned them (ruff==0.15.20, pytest-cov==7.1.0, coverage==7.15.0) in requirements-dev.txt plus a new [project.optional-dependencies] dev extra. Fixed pyproject [tool.ruff] src=['src'] -> src=['flaskr','tests'], set line-length=88 and [tool.ruff.lint] select=[E,F,W,I]. Ran ruff check --fix (11 import-sort fixes) and wrapped one long docstring in test_factory.py; ruff check now clean. Added [tool.coverage.report] show_missing + fail_under=90; pytest --cov measures branch coverage from [tool.coverage.run] branch=true (33 passed, 99% total, gate green). Documented the lint/coverage commands in README.rst and added .github/workflows/ci.yml running ruff check + pytest --cov on push/PR.
spec:
1. Install ruff and pytest-cov as dev dependencies.
2. Configure ruff rules in pyproject.toml (currently [tool.ruff] src=['src'] which does not match the flaskr/ layout).
3. Run ruff check on flaskr/ and tests/ and fix any violations.
4. Run pytest with coverage reporting and verify branch coverage is measured.
5. Document the lint and coverage commands in README.
6. Optionally add a pre-commit hook or CI workflow that runs lint + coverage + tests.
